messages:
maria: hey folks — customer reported SSO failures after their IdP cert rotate. SAML assertion validates signatures but SCIM provisioning returns 400. Error log says unexpected xml namespace on attributes. anyone hit this before? cc @jon @eli

jon: seen it once. some IdPs started adding a default xmlns on <Attribute> which breaks our SCIM attr matcher (we expect no namespace). can you paste a sanitized assertion?

maria: here (sanitized):
```xml
<saml:Assertion ...>
  <saml:AttributeStatement>
    <saml:Attribute Name=\"urn:custom:attrs:employeeId\" xmlns=\"urn:okta:schemas\">
      <saml:AttributeValue>12345</saml:AttributeValue>
    </saml:Attribute>
  </saml:AttributeStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```

eli: yep — that `xmlns` on the Attribute element is the culprit. our parser does a strict local-name match and drops anything with a namespace. okta changed behavior in a minor upgrade a few weeks ago.

ashley: quick Q: we also rotated KMS keys last night and rewrapped platform keys. could that impact signature verification? logs look like sigs verified fine.

maria: signatures verify. stacktrace from scim-provisioner shows: `400 Bad Request — attribute not found: user:employeeId` and the incoming map shows the attribute name includes the namespace prefix at parse time. KMS audit shows rewrap at 2026-03-21T13:02Z but unrelated to SAML signature.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-021 — "IdP xmlns on SAML Attribute breaks SCIM attr mapping". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-021 :lock:

jon: short-term mitigation: add an edge transform to strip attribute namespaces for affected tenants. minimal XSLT we used before: 
```xslt
<xsl:stylesheet version=\"1.0\" xmlns:xsl=\"http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform\">
  <xsl:output method=\"xml\"/>
  <xsl:template match=\"@*|node()\">
    <xsl:copy>
      <xsl:apply-templates select=\"@*|node()\"/>
    </xsl:copy>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- strip namespace on Attribute -->
  <xsl:template match=\"*:Attribute\">
    <Attribute>
      <xsl:apply-templates select=\"@*|node()\"/>
    </Attribute>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
```

eli: I'll open a PR to make the SCIM parser tolerant (fallback to local-name matching) and add unit tests with namespaced attributes. long-term we should ask IdP to revert the schema change or document it. assign to @eli and @jon, ETA EOW.

maria: i'll reach out to the customer's IdP admin and apply the transform as a canary for that tenant. please add a feature toggle so we can rollback quickly. :thumbsup:

ashley: adding canary flag to console and will deploy to staging first. will post deploy-bot logs when done.

deploy-bot: deployment started for `scim-proxy/namespace-strip` -> staging 

jon: after staging smoke we can enable for the single affected tenant and monitor SCIM success rate + KMS audit. plan looks good.

maria: thanks team — i'll update INC ticket and customer. ping me if you need test assertions.

ashley: acked, will watch logs and revert if anything odd shows up.
